newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Bank Handlowy '96 net PLN 556 mln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Bank Handlowy '96 net PLN 556 mln - paper.

text.p: Poland's biggest commercial bank, Bank Handlowy SA, had a net profit of 556 million zlotys in 1996 against 426 million zlotys in 1995, the Rzeczpospolita daily said on Monday.
The bank is slated for privatisation this year,

Bank Handlowy officials did not confirm the data saying they were preliminary and did not include the results of Handlowy's London branch. The bank's spokeswoman said full results would be published in two weeks.
The paper said the bank's gross profit last year was 771 million zlotys against 731 million in 1995. Revenue from interest was 658 million zlotys against 667 million in 1995.
Revenue from commission in 1996 was 149 million zlotys aganist 111 million and revenue from operations on securities was 113 million against 24 million.
Revenue on banking operations was 1.03 billion zlotys against 1.17 billion in 1995, the paper said.
